definitions.Force: Threshold detected fewer vectors than floor(.2*input_width); author code instead selects that many smallest-eigenvalue vectors.
definitions.Auto: Threshold-selected vectors reach floor; never observed in these canonical records.
definitions.canonical_pct10: S01..06 original, S07..13 IO branch, S14..18 third branch, S19 fourth branch; exclude abandoned next-stage localizers using source receipts and exact canonical stage-complete hashes.
definitions.rounded_ratio: Original printed natural-null percentage has two decimals; 0.00% is not an exact full-rank proof.

limitations: Applies only this LLaVA PaRSP 1% and10% completed trajectory, not other algorithms/backbones/seeds.
Forced floor does not prove harmful gradient removal, current-task nonconvergence or impaired acquisition.
Original logs contain no pre-mask/pre-projector dense gradient, actual Adam deltaW, constraint leakage or paired before/after current CE.
Selection counts are registered trainability, not effective permitted dense coefficients after masking/projection.
The forced subspace can contain small nonzero covariance eigenvalues: it is not necessarily a strict mathematical nullspace.
